title: CURRENT ACCESS NOTICE: Coral Light Chamber, Dar es Salaam

The Coral Light Chamber session begins with a short safety briefing. Demonstrators explain the equipment before visitors work in small groups. Space in the activity area is limited, so loan equipment must be booked before arrival.

Access details: visitors who reserved the Coral Light Chamber for the Dar es Salaam stop must collect the kit from the east registration kiosk. Collection begins at 10:50. Staff will ask for the booking email before releasing a kit, and an adult must accompany visitors under sixteen.

The return desk closes forty minutes after the final demonstration. General admission questions belong at reception; reception does not distribute reserved equipment. Changes are announced on the venue notice board.

title: CURRENT ACCESS NOTICE: Water Turbidity Lab, Mwanza
text:
The travelling science programme reaches Lake Hall on Station Road in Mwanza on 8 July. The programme is fictional and its notices are written for this retrieval exercise. Volunteers welcome school groups, independent visitors, and teachers throughout the day.

The Water Turbidity Lab session begins with a short safety briefing. Demonstrators explain the equipment before visitors work in small groups. Space in the activity area is limited, so loan equipment must be booked before arrival.

Access details: visitors who reserved the Water Turbidity Lab for the Mwanza stop must collect the kit from the indigo equipment desk. Collection begins at 10:50. Staff will ask for the booking email before releasing a kit, and an adult must accompany visitors under sixteen.

The return desk closes forty minutes after the final demonstration. General admission questions belong at reception; reception does not distribute reserved equipment. Changes are announced on the venue notice board.
